dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Ho there, citizen! If you require shelter, simply head to the belltower in the city center.

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: The savages have been getting all bold and uppity lately, so be on your guard!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Lauretus Vicetinus am I, under the auxilia of Machimos's Legio III!

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: So long as we are here, we shall suffer no despicable invaders to step within the city walls!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You mean the belltower?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Indeed! These are days of fire and sword, after all, and as soldiers of the Imperator, our God-King, we cannot allow our imperial citizens to be exposed to danger.

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Someone in the belltower will guide you to Machimos. You shall be safe there.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the barbarians...

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Those savages? There's nothing to be said for those detestable invaders! They destroy our cities, slaughter our people...

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Enemies of the empire I name them... Nay, enemies of all civilization!

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Still, you need not fear, citizen! Dominus Boethius shall soon come to Machimos in person.

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: When that happens, all disturbances shall be utterly quelled, and those putrid primitives shall get what they deserve!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Fare ye well, citizen!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there, dear guests! I'm Loredan Vicentino, a student of Master Giovanni's!

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: If you wish to order instruments, please seek my master instead.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A beautiful melody?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Indeed! Just as my brothers and sisters have, organizing performances at the Opera Epiclese to endless plaudits and applause...

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: That said, I'm not at their level. I must work harder, practice harder, to maintain the prestige of our family!

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: That's why I've stayed in town, working for Master Giovanni on one hand, while honing my musical craft on the other.

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: One day, people will surely say of me, "Ah, indeed, you are a descendent of the Vicentino family!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: See you, dear guest from afar!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: City walls? Where'd they come from?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are we not within our defensive walls as we speak?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Ah, wait, I see... You're testing me! Why, just as Dominus Boethius once said, "the mighty legions are the true walls of the empire"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you met any barbarians?

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Hmm... No, not yet, I fear. They're a cunning lot, I must say. They rarely show up when they cannot be sure of victory...

dialogues.speaker: Loredan
dialogues.text: Ah, if only I could play such a wonderful melody...
